notes.title: Hawthorn Kickstarter Last Call
notes.content: [p]Only 30 minutes left to get the exclusive Hawthorn [url="https://www.PlayHawthorn.com/crowdfunding" buttoncolor="#31ed3d"]Kickstarter [/url]rewards. After 10pm EDT tonight the Pledge Manager will close and Hawthorn's Kickstarter campaign will conclude. [/p][p][/p][p]Click the green "Join the Adventure" button on the Hawthorn Kickstarter page to select a tier that speaks to you![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to all our amazing backers who are making this game a reality and allowing our small team to keep plugging away on this dream project![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for updates![/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter Pledge Manager Closing Sept 22nd And Other Updates!
notes.content: [p align="start"]Hello Villagers,[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We are officially [b]closing[/b] the [b]Hawthorn[/b] [b]Kickstarter Pledge Manager[/b] on [b]Monday, September 22nd at 10pm EDT[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]What does this mean?[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]For Potential New Kickstarter Backers[/b]: [/p][p align="start"]This is the FINAL chance to back Hawthorn's Kickstarter campaign and get the game's exclusive rewards! If you have been considering the idea of supporting the project, this is your moment. Come join the adventure![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]For Current Kickstarter Backers[/b]:[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your support! Hawthorn has been made possible because of you. If you have been eyeing a different tier, now is the time to snag that upgrade! Please fill out the pledge manager survey if you haven't already. Lastly, please spread the word that this is the last chance for new backers. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]OTHER UPDATES[/b]:[/p][p align="start"]We know it’s been a little quiet here the past couple of months, and we wanted to take a moment to share what has been happening behind the scenes. The team has been heads down, hard at work on all the big pieces that will bring [i]Hawthorn[/i] to life. We are a small team and we’ve been giving everything we have to building [i]Hawthorn[/i] and its future.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here’s a look at what we’ve been up to:[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Development:[/b] We’ve been adding new core gameplay features and expanding, tuning and polishing existing systems. Every week brings us closer to the world we all want to explore together.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Marketing & Showcases:[/b] We’ve been working on executing on our self publishing and marketing roadmap, including prepping for upcoming festivals and showcases. We will have update about that in the future. You may have seen that we were at PAX recently, going around and talking to gamers about Hawthorn and trying to raise awareness of the game. We were also honored to be invited by Kickstarter to speak on a panel at SLICE to other indie developers about running a Kickstarter campaign![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Team & Partnerships:[/b] We’ve been talking with art and localization partners, and continuing to grow our internal team so we can fill skill gaps and add more content to the game.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Publishing Conversations:[/b] Over the last couple of weeks, we’ve been in deeper conversations with dozens of publishers. While we are still pursuing our self-publishing path, we’re also exploring whether a partner who deeply believes in [i]Hawthorn[/i] could help us bring the game to even more players around the world.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you so much for your patience, your trust, and your continued support. We’ll be sharing more development updates in the Hawthorn Discord (including new gameplay and art!) soon, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Less than 30 Minutes Left for Hawthorn's Kickstarter
notes.content: [p]We're down to the final 30 minutes of [i]Hawthorn’s [/i]Late Pledge campaign and this is the last chance to get the exclusive Kickstarter rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]We just hit our Village Morale Stretch Goal! We can't wait to share more about how this feature will work.[/p][p][/p][p]This community's support during this final phase has been amazing, and we’re on the verge of making even more of [i]Hawthorn[/i] a reality. We truly are building this with our players and our backers have a front row seat. [/p][p][/p][p]Join our Village Council along with our current backers and be an important part of this crazy adventure of building Hawthorn with us! Please share this campaign one last time. Every bit of support in this final hour makes a real difference and now is the moment.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.PlayHawthorn.com/crowdfunding"]www.PlayHawthorn.com/crowdfunding[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Today, we celebrate the 3-year anniversary of NEARstudios, the company that was formed to bring this team together and start building this game. It's crazy how fast time flies when you are doing the thing that makes you happy. Here's to many years to come![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for helping us bring [i]Hawthorn[/i] to life. Let’s give this one last big push across the finish line![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Late Pledges for Hawthorn will end on Friday, July 11th at 4pm ET.
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]Late Pledges for Hawthorn will end on Friday, July 11th at 4pm ET.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Less than [b]72 hours[/b] before Hawthorn’s Kickstarter [b]Late Pledge campaign ends[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]Last chance to secure the exclusive Kickstarter in-game items and be a part of our early [b]Village Council[/b] community with the “[b]Kickstarter Supporter[/b]” role and your chosen tiered Discord role, as well as other exciting rewards![/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]We are so thankful to our community for [b]successfully funding[/b] the main campaign last month over [b]211%[/b]! With Kickstarter’s the Late Pledge feature, we were able to keep the campaign open for people who are just now hearing about the game and/or Kickstarter and who want to join us on this adventure. [/p][p][/p][p]Today, does mark the final push on the Kickstarter platform for Hawthorn and we will need your help to reach [b]one last stretch goal[/b] and that is the “[b]Village Morale System[/b].” This is the big, exciting 2nd layer of progression for the game outside of your individual character progression and it determines how the village will be able to coordinate and grow together. It will affect your relationships and individual progression. Trust us when we say this is one of those systems, we are very excited about expanding over time.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Consider pledging now to help us shoot past this goal all while celebrating the 3 year anniversary of NEARstudios in the process![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][url="https://www.PlayHawthorn.com/Crowdfunding"]Kickstarter[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Backing the game on Kickstarter allows us to maintain creative autonomy to bring this game to the community the way we have always dreamed![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Part of this celebration is our team working with our early [b]content creator[/b] supporters/collaborators and providing [b]access to the Hawthorn Proof-of-Concept playtest[/b], so they can help us bring new folks into this wonderful community and help us reach that last stretch goal, with less than $8k to go! [b]Please like and subscribe to any creators you see out there making content about Hawthorn[/b] as they are helping us promote the Kickstarter organically, since we don’t have a the budget for marketing at the moment. We'd like to spread the love around and support them as much as we can in these early days.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]After Friday, July 11th at 4pm ET[/b], our current backers will then have an [b]additional 72 hours to change their pledge within the Pledge Manager[/b], which will be accessible after the official close of the Late Pledge Campaign. We will send out a reminder announcement then.[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to Wishlist the game, signup on our the Hawthorn [b][url="https://www.playHawthorn.com"]website[/url][/b][url="https://www.playHawthorn.com"] [/url]and encourage others to do the same since word of mouth and every little bit of traction goes a long way![/p][p][/p][p]Let’s end this Kickstarter chapter on a strong note and build something special together![/p][p] [/p][p]Forever grateful,[/p][p]The Hawthorn Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter Ending! Housing & Morale!
notes.content:
Wow! We’ve shot past our $400,000 USD Kickstarter stretch goal well before the end of the campaign today! The Kickstarter is more than 200% funded! This means Hawthorn will have housing. Thank you so much, dear backers, for inviting your friends and contacts and making this possible!
Now, you and your villagers will be able to claim those little animal cottages, nestled among the roots of the great oak.
Assign a home to each villager, including yourself, then customize each one to suit its owner’s tastes. Decorate, rearrange, and make every nook cozy. Either help the NPCs decorating their homes, or, if that’s a bit much for you, you can let them decorate on their own.
At day’s end, NPCs will retire to their cottages to rest, and so can you! You’re not just building a village. Now you can actually live the cottage life!

[b]Another Kickstarter Mystery Goal Revealed![/b]
As always, meeting a Kickstarter stretch goal means that there is a new mystery goal coming up, this time at the $450,000 USD mark. Since the campaign ends today, we’re announcing right now that this mystery goal is “Village Morale”.
Rebuilding a village and homesteading isn’t a walk in the park! Each villager, NPCs and players, will have things that they want, preferences in food, home, décor, and eventually much more. With Village Morale, supplying what each villager needs will make them happier and thereby improve the morale of the whole village, and this will affect not just the way the villagers behave but also how fast the village can progress, looking to the future.
If we don’t reach this “Village Morale” goal by the end of the campaign today, we do have late pledges enabled. We could actually make many more stretch goals through late pledges if we keep spreading the word!

[b]A Discord Party![/b]
Join the Hawthorn Discord for a party today at 3:30PM EDT (US) where NEARstudios will be celebrating with our community as the Kickstarter comes to its official close. We might even livestream some of the Hawthorn proof-of-concept demo...
Also please wishlist Hawthorn on Steam! Steam wishlists will be very important to proving our traction with Hawthorn.

[b]Finishing Strong[/b]
This Kickstarter campaign officially ends June 5th at 4PM EDT (though, as mentioned, late pledges are enabled). It has been a whirlwind! We met our funding goal just over a week in. Then we voted in Hummingbirds as a new pet. We enabled the foundation for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter in Hawthorn. We unlocked one of the first main story beats, the Hawthorn House, followed by the Storyteller System and travelling NPCs that players can name and customize with a Kickstarter add-on. And now Housing!

We’ve been blown away by the love and support of our community, by the sharing, the donations. Thank you so, so much!

notes.title: Kickstarter: One Week Left! Support Hawthorn Today!
notes.content:
Hawthorn’s Kickstarter has come a long way in three short weeks! We’ve not only reached our initial funding goal, but have also unlocked three more goals! With your support, we will now be adding:
[list]
[*] Tameable Hummingbird pets
[*] Foundational gameplay for Spring, Summer, Winter, and Fall
[*] A main story chapter: “Hawthorn House”
[/list]
We’re overwhelmed by the momentum so far, but the journey is not over yet! There is one week left to the current campaign! We warmly invite all our followers to continue sharing the Kickstarter with your friends, family, and fellow adventurers. There’s still time to make Hawthorn even bigger, including our upcoming “mystery” gameplay goal, and after that, our much-anticipated housing and building system!

Meanwhile, our little team is hard at work preparing some exciting announcements we hope to share in the coming week. Stay tuned!

In other exciting news, Hawthorn is officially taking part in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyFamilyFriendlyGamesCelebration2025]Steam’s Cozy & Family Friendly Games Celebration 2025[/url] as an Upcoming Game! This event starts on Steam today and runs through June 2nd, showcasing a lot of great games and discounts.

Once again, our most heartfelt thanks go out to every one of you who has backed this journey and helped to bring the world of Hawthorn to life!

notes.title: The Hawthorn Kickstarter is Live! Support Us Today!
notes.content:
[img]https://playhawthorn.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/HawthornKickstarterStoryTrailerPromo.png[/img]

[url=www.nearstudios.com]NEARstudios[/url] is proud (and yes, a little terrified) to announce the launch of the Hawthorn [url=www.playhawthorn.com/crowdfunding][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] campaign!

[url=www.playhawthorn.com]Hawthorn[/url] is our passion project set in a realm where humble woodland fairytale creatures chase adventure. Where ancient myths seemingly stir just beneath the moss and roots, and where stories and rumors grow like ivy. 

Hawthorn is part epic adventure, part cozy day-in-the-life told through the lens of classic fairytale storybooks and fantasy adventure books. 

This [url=www.playhawthorn.com/crowdfunding][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] is more than a funding push; it’s a rallying cry. A stand for creative freedom. For the artists fighting to hold onto their visions in a risk-averse industry. And for anyone who’s ever dreamed of stepping into a world shaped by heart, courage, and imagination.
 
We’ve been quietly putting in countless hours of planning and preparation for this moment, but we’re thrilled to bring our community along for the journey! 
 
Bring Hawthorn to life with us:

[url=www.PlayHawthorn.com/Crowdfunding][b]www.PlayHawthorn.com/Crowdfunding[/b][/url]
 
Check out our campaign page to learn more about the exclusive in-game items, early bird backer discounts, exciting stretch goals that our supporters can unlock and [b]access to Hawthorn’s Pre-Production Concept Demo[/b]!

As a small, self-funded team that’s poured everything into this passion project, today is a huge milestone for us — and we need your help to keep going! 

The first day of the campaign is [b]crucial[/b]. Early pledges and shares help boost Hawthorn’s visibility on Kickstarter, giving us an edge in the algorithm and making it more likely that we’ll get funded! Making any pledge during the first 24 hours, no matter the amount, will make a huge impact, so please support us today! 

[b]Other ways you can help: [/b]

•	🐭 Sharing the link on social media 
•	🦉 Sharing  it in your favorite online communities 
•	🦦 Sending it to friends and family who you want to play with! 

If Hawthorn made you feel something—a flicker of wonder, a spark of adventure—consider backing or sharing our [url=www.playhawthorn.com/crowdfunding]Kickstarter[/url]. 

Thank you all for being part of this incredible journey, we truly could not do it without you! Spread the word about the campaign and let’s bring Hawthorn to life! 

— The Hawthorn Team

notes.title: Hawthorn Dev Q&A
notes.content:

We’re thrilled to share that we'll be hosting our first-ever developer Q&A session in our [url=www.discord.gg/hawthorn]Discord[/url] server on Dec. 10th from 3:00 - 4:00 PM EST!

We love seeing the questions you all have posted so far and we’re excited to bring our whole community together in one place to answer your most burning questions about the team’s background or life at NEARstudios in general! 

We intend to host many more Q&As in the coming months to highlight a variety of topics and team members, including a session centered around the world and lore in January, so make sure to join us on Discord [b]www.discord.gg/hawthorn[/b] for the opportunity to learn more about the world of Hawthorn before anyone else! notes.title: Redwall meets Skyrim in this new game from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog alumni
notes.content:
Why, Hawthorn, must you put in me a position where I have to balance my love of woodland fantasy against my complete exhaustion with chopping things down to build other things? There are two scurrying mammals wearing robes inside of me, and they both love Redwall, Mice And Mystics, and Mouse Guard, but might spontaneously combust if they have to craft another hatchet. A trailer, eh? Is...is that a mouse and an otter dancing on top of a table, each grasping a mug of ale in their tiny paws and dancing to fiddle music? Fine! Fine! I’m not happy about this, but Fine!
